title: Minimax and adaptive inference for branching ratios under long memory
summary: The branching ratio $ρ$ of a self-exciting point process determines the branching margin $1-ρ$ to the critical boundary. We study inference on $ρ$ from a finite record for stationary Hawkes processes with completely monotone kernels whose slow relaxation mass obeys an envelope near zero rate. Slow excitation can then be exchanged for exogenous immigration; a spectral bound on the Kullback--Leibler rate and a coupling argument for the unobserved past give a minimax lower bound of order $T^{-γ/(2γ+1)}$ for a power-law envelope with tail exponent $γ$.
